title: a-probe-resolves-its-owning-ticket-through-the-one-locator

decisions.text: owning_ticket resolves through grammar.ticket_path (lazy import inside the function) and re-derives nothing; None becomes the existing {unresolvable:<root>/<name>.json} hole.
decisions.by: derived from Law 1 and ticket_path's docstring ('the one implementation'); Akien 2026-09-15: 'we need to fix things that come up too. time to ticket those'

decisions.text: The hole contract (a string naming the path looked at, never None) is unchanged for all 92 call sites.
decisions.by: derived from probe.py owning_ticket's docstring (Law 7) — measured 92 live sites, 84 distinct names

decisions.text: ticket_path checks the literal <claim>.json file first, before _HEX_ID_RE and _TICKET_RE, so a full <id>-<slug> stem resolves regardless of its leading character.
decisions.by: derived from ticket_spellings (the stem is a spelling a ticket answers to) and measured: digit-leading stem 4431cf2bc625-... refused today, a-f-leading stems resolve by accident

decisions.text: The .json extension stays literal in this ticket; e78c9858f5fb changes it, now in one place.
decisions.by: derived from ticket e78c9858f5fb (records-of-truth-carry-one-extension-artifact, TICKETME:waiting) — its scope, not this one's

intention: A probe resolves its owning ticket through the one ticket locator, so a hex-id ticket's probe carries a path, not a hole, and the tickets lookup lives in one place.
why: Law 1: two implementations of 'where does a ticket live' is a re-derivation, and today they disagree (9 holes + 1 refusal over 84 names). Law 7: the hole stays visible. Serves e78c9858f5fb by leaving it one place to change.
how: cairn/tools/base/probe.py owning_ticket delegates to cairn.tools.chain.grammar.ticket_path(name, tickets_dir=root) via a lazy import; grammar.ticket_path moves its literal-file check ahead of the regex gates; a census tooth and a scratch-dir tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py and a stem tooth in cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_chain_grammar.py; both proofs resealed under the tester.
falsifier: DONE when, measured by a tooth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py that censuses every probes/*.py under the repo: for each literal owning_ticket argument, owning_ticket(name) and grammar.ticket_path(name) name the same file or both report nothing (0 disagreements; today 10 of 84 — 9 hex ids that hole while ticket_path resolves, 1 digit-leading stem that resolves while ticket_path refuses); a scratch tickets dir proves the three spellings (hex id, slug, <id>-<slug> stem) resolve through owning_ticket(tickets_root=) and a missing one still returns the {unresolvable:<path>} hole; grep -rn "*-" over probe.py finds no tickets glob (one implementation left, in grammar.py). WRONG INTENT if a live probe's carry needs a name the locator cannot serve (none in the census).
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel); Law 7 (errors loud at diagnostic surfaces); serves e78c9858f5fb.
